prompt:
Scene:
Same straight-on catalog shot of the reference triptych, same lighting, same frame, same velvet backdrop. The central panel has been re-imaged.

Subject:
The identical triptych frame, grid density, bead lines and copper moulding are preserved. The central panel now shows a Saint of Data — a standing robed figure whose chest is an open compartment revealing a cluster of backlit colored glass cells arranged as a tidy bar-chart pattern. In both hands the saint holds small ribbon-like ledgers of stitched light, each ribbon depicting an abstract line chart in the colored-glass cells. Side panels unchanged but with small chart-reading attendants.

Important details:
Preserve exact frame proportions, bead cadence and copper moulding from the reference. Chart shapes must look like proper data visualizations — bar heights varied, line chart has monotonic slopes — but no numeric labels, no axis text. The chest compartment must read as a deliberate design element, framed by its own smaller copper arch. Color palette: saint robe in cool ultramarine, charts in amber / coral / teal cells.

Use case:
Stained Glass LED Altar series image 3/4, depends on reference altar; showcases Saint of Data variation.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no numerals on charts, no brand visualization logos, no modern interface icons, no monetary symbols, keep triptych frame identity from reference.
title: Saint of Data
description: The reference triptych with a Saint of Data whose chest compartment shows backlit colored-glass bar charts and who holds ribbon ledgers of stitched light.
